div.div:
1 Capture-scan lag
Grace-window headroom (sev2); Repair-read storm (sev2)
2 Environment recreate
Scheduled event; alert suppression window; no active alert or severity
3 Entra token edge cases
Doomed reconnect loop (sev2)
4 Poison event, head-of-line blocking
Systemic poison (sev1); Parking failure (sev1); Parked events present (sev2)
5 Consumer rebalance redelivery
Rebalances, spot evictions, repair throttling (sev3)
6 Mid-stream or head gap
Loss-rate trend (sev2)
7 Tail loss
Tail-drift rate (sev2)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 684px; height: 1px; padding-top: 639px; margin-left: 731px;

div.div:
8 Duplicate side effects
Notifier degraded (sev2)
9 Tenant mis-attribution
Attribution mismatch (sev1)
10 Connect worker loss
Rebalances, spot evictions, repair throttling (sev3)
11 Shared-worker blast radius
Partial fleet outage (sev1)
12 Kafka broker loss at build scale
Fleet stream outage (sev1)
13 Offset or schema-history topic loss
Internal topic loss (sev1)
Catalogue exception
FM2 follows the suppression rule. FM4 lists every matching alert because the catalogue assigns two severities.
